agency.name: Alaska Division of Behavioral Health (Department of Health)

narrNote: No Alaska affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22). Per doctrine the field is left null rather than substituting a non-NARR organization.
notes: countyDirectory is null: Alaska has no county system (boroughs and census areas instead) and the Division of Behavioral Health does not publish a county-based provider directory; Alaska 211 provides the regional resource search. DBH's own page publishes phone 907-465-3370 and confirms it manages the 1115 Behavioral Health Reform Medicaid programs, which cover mental health and substance use disorder services (ASAM levels of care including residential and withdrawal management). Careline Alaska is the statewide 24/7 crisis line and Alaska's 988 call center, funded by the State of Alaska Department of Health (per its own site). Alaska 211: dial 211 or 1-800-478-2221 (per its homepage). Recover Alaska is a statewide multi-sector coalition focused on reducing alcohol harm; NAMI Alaska runs peer-led Connection recovery support groups statewide. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
